n46ee8d61d7.headline: Marinakis: Consumers will not be left at the mercy of excessive price hikes for power
n46ee8d61d7.summary: Government spokesperson Pavlos Marinakis said consumers will not be left at the mercy of excessive electricity price increases, in an interview with a Greek newspaper.

n05b3a68774.headline: Senegal's governing party poised for parliamentary majority in boost for reform agenda
n05b3a68774.summary: Senegal's governing party is poised to win a majority of seats in the National Assembly, a result that would support its reform agenda.
n05b3a68774.why: A parliamentary majority determines whether a government can pass economic and fiscal legislation, which matters for investors in its sovereign debt and projects.

ncd34f55740.headline: South African rand firms on S&P outlook upgrade
ncd34f55740.summary: The rand gained on Monday after S&P revised South Africa's outlook to positive from stable, citing plans for accelerated economic reforms. It traded at 18.12 per dollar.
ncd34f55740.why: Credit rating outlooks influence sovereign borrowing costs and foreign investor appetite for South African assets, and the rand is a key emerging-market currency.

n57799bec9f.headline: Brazil fiscal package done but defense ministry OK pending, Haddad says
n57799bec9f.summary: Brazil's government spending-cut package is practically done and will be released soon, pending only a response from the defence ministry, Finance Minister Fernando Haddad said.
n57799bec9f.why: Brazil's fiscal plan affects government debt sustainability, interest rates and the outlook for its currency and bonds.

n8d32f63106.headline: Warning to supermarket shoppers as the price of butter soars across the UK
n8d32f63106.summary: Butter prices have risen at Asda, Sainsbury's, Tesco, Morrisons, Aldi and Lidl amid supply shortages, according to a UK report.
n8d32f63106.why: Food inflation at major UK grocers feeds into consumer price indices and retailer margins.

n592af8df5d.headline: Spirit Airlines files for bankruptcy as financial losses pile up and debt payments loom
n592af8df5d.summary: Spirit, the biggest U.S. budget airline, filed for bankruptcy after losing more than $2.5 billion since the start of 2020. It faces debt payments above $1 billion over the next year.
n592af8df5d.why: Spirit is a US low-cost carrier, and airline bankruptcies affect aircraft lessors, fuel demand and competing carriers' fares and capacity.
n592af8df5d.why_moved: Spirit has lost over $2.5 billion since 2020 and faces more than $1 billion in debt payments over the next year, which led to the bankruptcy filing.

nf17c149d84.headline: G20 summit calls for more aid to Gaza and an end to the war in Ukraine

n0faf943628.headline: Brazil’s G20 summit produces a broad declaration that’s short on specifics
n0faf943628.summary: The Group of 20 leading economies produced a joint declaration at their Rio de Janeiro summit on Monday. The declaration was described as broad but short on specifics.
n0faf943628.why: The G20 brings together the world's largest economies, and its joint declarations signal coordination on trade, debt and growth policy that affects global markets.

na7c9d7fb9d.headline: Middle East tensions are a crude awakening for Japan’s energy security strategy
na7c9d7fb9d.summary: Escalating Middle East tensions are prompting Japan to consider diplomacy, security steps and better use of government emergency oil stockpiles.
na7c9d7fb9d.why: Japan imports nearly all of its crude oil, so Middle East supply risks directly affect its energy costs and policy.

na85bec7c20.headline: North American Morning Briefing :  Nasdaq Futures -2-

na85bec7c20.why: Escalation of the Ukraine conflict affects energy markets, defence stocks and broader geopolitical risk premiums.

n5860076625.summary: Wall Street had its worst week in 10 years, spoiling the post-election rally. Investors are watching interest rates and Nvidia as the day ahead unfolds in U.S. and global markets.
n5860076625.why: Wall Street's major indexes are benchmarks for global equity performance. Nvidia is the leading supplier of AI chips and a bellwether for the technology sector.

n34887adf7d.summary: Currency depreciation is set to reverse years of declining inflation in Venezuela, according to public and private sector assessments reported by Reuters. The country's economy is described as beleaguered.
